description: MLOps board of the RUL model: production model and its holdout metrics, every training run with its promotion decision, calibration, and the live backtest against failures that happened later.

panels.title: Production model
panels.description: Newest promoted run of the training registry (ml_model_runs.promoted = 1): the model production.json points to.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model_version
FROM ml_model_runs
WHERE promoted = 1
ORDER BY trained_at DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Serving model
panels.description: Model that produced the newest prediction (gold_engine_rul_predictions). It differs from the production model only until the predictor's next round after a promotion.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT model_version
FROM gold_engine_rul_predictions
WHERE predicted_at > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY predicted_at DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Production model holdout metrics
panels.description: Holdout metrics of the production model, measured on lifecycles it never saw (split by lifecycle). Colours follow the promotion floors: R² >= PROMOTION_MIN_R2 (0.5), ROC-AUC >= PROMOTION_MIN_ROC_AUC (0.75). Brier and ECE measure the calibration of failure_probability (runs before calibration existed have none).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    rmse AS `RMSE (cycles)`,
    r2 AS `R²`,
    clf_f1 AS `F1`,
    clf_roc_auc AS `ROC-AUC`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'clf_brier', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `Brier`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'clf_ece', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `ECE`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'decision_threshold', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `Threshold`
FROM ml_model_runs
WHERE promoted = 1
ORDER BY trained_at DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Holdout RMSE per training run
panels.description: RMSE of every training run on its holdout lifecycles; green dots were promoted, red ones were not (champion/challenger gate: the challenger must beat the champion's RMSE on the same holdout and keep F1 within PROMOTION_F1_TOLERANCE). The dashed line is that champion's RMSE on the challenger's holdout, the thin line the late-life RMSE (true RUL within the 125-cycle cap).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    trained_at AS time,
    if(promoted = 1, rmse, NULL) AS `RMSE (promoted)`,
    if(promoted = 0, rmse, NULL) AS `RMSE (not promoted)`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'champion_rmse', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `champion on the same holdout`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'late_life_rmse', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `late-life RMSE`
FROM ml_model_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(trained_at)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Holdout R² and failure classifier per training run
panels.description: R² of the RUL regressor and F1 / precision / recall / ROC-AUC of the imminent-failure classifier at its tuned threshold. Dashed lines: the promotion floors R² 0.5 and ROC-AUC 0.75.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    trained_at AS time,
    r2 AS `R²`,
    clf_f1 AS `F1`,
    clf_precision AS `precision`,
    clf_recall AS `recall`,
    clf_roc_auc AS `ROC-AUC`
FROM ml_model_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(trained_at)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Calibration of failure_probability
panels.description: Brier score and expected calibration error (10 bins) of the calibrated classifier, on the holdout and out-of-fold (lifecycle-grouped 5-fold CV the Platt scaling was fitted on). Stored in ml_model_runs.params_json; empty for runs trained before calibration was added.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    trained_at AS time,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'clf_brier', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `Brier (holdout)`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'clf_ece', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `ECE (holdout)`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'calibration', 'oof_brier', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `Brier (out-of-fold)`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'calibration', 'oof_ece', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `ECE (out-of-fold)`
FROM ml_model_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(trained_at)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Model registry
panels.description: Training runs in the range, newest first (ml_model_runs): data volume, holdout metrics, the promotion decision with its reason, and the artifact in the lakehouse bucket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    trained_at AS `Trained (UTC)`,
    model_version AS `Model version`,
    promoted AS `Promoted`,
    JSONExtractString(params_json, 'promotion', 'reason') AS `Promotion decision`,
    train_lifecycles AS `Train lifecycles`,
    test_lifecycles AS `Holdout lifecycles`,
    rmse AS `RMSE`,
    r2 AS `R²`,
    clf_f1 AS `F1`,
    clf_roc_auc AS `ROC-AUC`,
    JSONExtract(params_json, 'decision_threshold', 'Nullable(Float64)') AS `Threshold`,
    artifact_uri AS `Artifact`
FROM ml_model_runs
WHERE $__timeFilter(trained_at)
ORDER BY trained_at DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Live backtest (every prediction scored against the failure that followed)
Live vs holdout performance per model version
panels.description: rpt_model_live_performance (fleet-wide 'ALL' rows): each model version scored on the lifecycles that failed after it predicted them, next to its offline holdout RMSE. Bias > 0 means optimistic (failures came sooner than predicted). Warned: failed lifecycles with a HIGH-risk prediction before the failure. Missed in horizon: failed lifecycles the model scored inside the last 25 cycles without ever predicting HIGH (lifecycles it stopped scoring earlier, because a newer model took over, are not misses). Lead = cycles from the first HIGH warning to the failure.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    l.model_version AS `Model version`,
    r.promoted AS `Promoted`,
    l.lifecycles_covered AS `Failed lifecycles`,
    l.predictions_scored AS `Predictions`,
    r.rmse AS `Holdout RMSE`,
    l.rmse_cycles AS `Live RMSE`,
    l.late_life_rmse_cycles AS `Live late-life RMSE`,
    l.bias_cycles AS `Live bias`,
    l.mean_nasa_score AS `NASA score`,
    l.clf_precision AS `Precision`,
    l.clf_recall AS `Recall`,
    l.clf_f1 AS `F1`,
    l.lifecycles_warned AS `Warned`,
    m.missed_in_horizon AS `Missed in horizon`,
    l.median_warning_lead_cycles AS `Median lead (cycles)`
FROM rpt_model_live_performance AS l FINAL
LEFT JOIN ml_model_runs AS r ON r.model_version = l.model_version
LEFT JOIN
(
    -- failed lifecycles the model scored inside the horizon without ever saying HIGH
    SELECT model_version, countIf(scored_in_horizon = 1 AND high_predictions = 0) AS missed_in_horizon
    FROM
    (
        SELECT
            model_version,
            engine_id,
            lifecycle_id,
            max(actual_failure_within_horizon) AS scored_in_horizon,
            countIf(risk_band = 'HIGH') AS high_predictions
        FROM fct_rul_prediction_backtest FINAL
        GROUP BY model_version, engine_id, lifecycle_id
    )
    GROUP BY model_version
) AS m ON m.model_version = l.model_version
WHERE l.engine_model = 'ALL'
  AND $__conditionalAll(l.model_version IN (${model_version:singlequote}), $model_version)
ORDER BY l.model_version DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Holdout vs live RMSE by model version
panels.description: Offline holdout RMSE (ml_model_runs) against the live RMSE of the same model on lifecycles that failed after it went live (rpt_model_live_performance). A live error far above the holdout error would signal drift or leakage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    substring(l.model_version, 5) AS model,
    r.rmse AS `holdout RMSE`,
    l.rmse_cycles AS `live RMSE`,
    l.late_life_rmse_cycles AS `live late-life RMSE`
FROM rpt_model_live_performance AS l FINAL
LEFT JOIN ml_model_runs AS r ON r.model_version = l.model_version
WHERE l.engine_model = 'ALL'
  AND $__conditionalAll(l.model_version IN (${model_version:singlequote}), $model_version)
ORDER BY l.model_version
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Predicted vs actual RUL (live backtest)
panels.description: For every true remaining life (capped at 125 cycles, the regressor's target): the mean live prediction with its 10th-90th percentile band, against the perfect prediction. Above the diagonal = optimistic, below = conservative. Source: fct_rul_prediction_backtest (first scoring of every pre-failure pulse).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    actual_rul_cycles_capped AS `actual RUL`,
    avg(predicted_rul_cycles) AS `mean prediction`,
    quantile(0.1)(predicted_rul_cycles) AS `p10`,
    quantile(0.9)(predicted_rul_cycles) AS `p90`,
    toFloat64(actual_rul_cycles_capped) AS `perfect prediction`
FROM fct_rul_prediction_backtest FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(predicted_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model_version IN (${model_version:singlequote}), $model_version)
GROUP BY actual_rul_cycles_capped
ORDER BY actual_rul_cycles_capped

panels.title: Live absolute error over time
panels.description: Mean absolute error of the live predictions per model version, by prediction time (buckets of at least 10 minutes). Errors are measured against the true RUL capped at 125 cycles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    toStartOfInterval(predicted_at, toIntervalSecond(greatest($__interval_s, 600))) AS time,
    model_version,
    avg(abs_error_cycles) AS mean_abs_error_cycles
FROM fct_rul_prediction_backtest FINAL
WHERE $__timeFilter(predicted_at)
  AND $__conditionalAll(model_version IN (${model_version:singlequote}), $model_version)
GROUP BY time, model_version
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Warning lead time per failed lifecycle
panels.description: Cycles between a model's first HIGH-risk prediction of a lifecycle and its failure, plotted at the failure time (one point per model version and failed lifecycle). The dashed line is the 25-cycle horizon; failures without a HIGH warning are counted as 'Missed in horizon' above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, model_version, lead_cycles
FROM
(
    SELECT
        any(failure_ts) AS time,
        model_version,
        toInt32(any(failure_cycle))
            - toInt32(argMinIf(cycle_number, (predicted_at, telemetry_id), risk_band = 'HIGH'))
            AS lead_cycles
    FROM fct_rul_prediction_backtest FINAL
    WHERE $__timeFilter(failure_ts)
      AND $__conditionalAll(model_version IN (${model_version:singlequote}), $model_version)
    GROUP BY model_version, engine_id, lifecycle_id
    HAVING countIf(risk_band = 'HIGH') > 0
)
ORDER BY time
